marta: Heads up — we need to lock the model-catalog runway for Q3: onboarding cadence, pin policy, and deprecation/migration plan. Proposal: staggered cutover in 3 cohorts (shadow → soft-pin → full-swap). @kevin can you sketch capacity and SLA implications?
kevin: Yep. Quick calc: cohort size ~30% users first, then 30%, then 40%. Dedicated capacity for canaries + 20% buffer. Expect peak token QPS +18% during soft-pin weeks.
sophia: Putting some concrete acceptance gates so PM/Customer teams can sign off: P95 latency <= 300ms on hosted for gen endpoints, embed recall >= 0.88 on our customer sample, regression on safety/filters = 0. 1k sample per cohort for benching; A/B check with delta < 2% on task-level metrics.
jules: From infra/ML side: We need quant profiles per model variant. If we fallback to a quantized variant in cohort 2 we should mark it as 'compat' and run stability-run every 12h. Also verify KV cache warmup pattern for long conversations.
sophia: Can we standardize the bench harness? Suggest: 1) bench dataset = customer-sampled prompts + 200 curated edge cases, 2) perf harness outputs P50/P95/P99, token cost, and accuracy metrics.
marta: love that. Also propose pin TTL = 30 days for soft-pins, with automatic escalation to 7-day rollback if user-visible regressions exceed thresholds. Exceptions allowed for enterprise deals (manual opt-outs).
kevin: Ops notes: need a rollback playbook entry: if canary fails > 5% of checks across three consecutive runs -> auto re-route to previous pinned model. Also set traffic-shift step to 10% increments every 6 hours.
jules: For compatibility shims: plan to ship a light adapter that normalizes prompt schema for V2 models; cost ~2 engineer-weeks. That lets customers keep existing prompt shapes during migration.
sophia: Customer comms draft: migration email + 2-week notice and a 1-click downgrade in Console. Offer migration credits for customers who opt into early cohort.
meng-bot: canary-lane created: catalog-canary-q3-cohort1 (id: canary-326000) — monitors p95_latency, embed_recall, safety_fail_rate. Alerts -> #incidents if thresholds tripped.
marta: Decision items before next Thurs: 1) agree bench pass thresholds, 2) confirm pin TTL + exception flow, 3) sign off on canary traffic schedule, 4) capacity commit for cohort1.
kevin: I'll send capacity delta numbers and cost delta by EOD tomorrow.
jules: I'll scope the compat adapter and post PR for bench harness by Wed.
sophia: I'll draft comms + migration credit terms and loop in sales.
marta: OK — tagging owners: @kevin, @jules, @sophia. If no objections, we'll cut the runbook and schedule the first canary for 2026-07-07. :white_check_mark:
